style: Cute chibi anime mobile RPG {kind} art, 2.5-heads-tall proportions, big expressive eyes, soft cel shading with gentle gradients, clean thin lineart, bright pastel fantasy colors, polished game key-art quality.
tail: Full body, three-quarter view, centered, isolated on a plain flat light grey background. No text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

jobs.name: c_swordsman
jobs.d: A young swordsman hero with messy chestnut-brown hair, a light silver half-helm, a royal blue tunic with pale silver trim, brown leather belt and boots, holding a straight steel sword, confident friendly smile.

jobs.name: c_knight
jobs.d: A Lancewarden knight: deep navy plate armor with gold trim, a silver helmet with a red plume, a long crimson cape, holding a tall golden-tipped lance and a small round shield, determined heroic expression.

jobs.name: c_berserker
jobs.d: A berserker warrior: dark red leather and fur armor, a horned bone helmet, wild hair, holding a huge double-bladed battle axe, fierce grin, glowing red war paint.

jobs.name: c_mage
jobs.d: A young mage girl with long cream-white hair, a tall purple pointed wizard hat with gold band, purple robe with golden trim, holding a wooden staff topped with a glowing lilac crystal, gentle smile.

jobs.name: c_archmage
jobs.d: A Starfall Magus: deep wine-red robe with gold star embroidery, a dark cape lined with night sky, a gold star ornament on the hat, holding an orange glowing staff with tiny falling meteors around.

jobs.name: c_elementalist
jobs.d: An elementalist sorcerer: teal robe with mint-green trim, a floating green gem above the hat, small swirling wind ribbons and floating stones around the hands, calm focused look.

jobs.name: c_archer
jobs.d: A cheerful archer with golden blond hair, a green cap with a red feather, a moss-green tunic, brown leather quiver on the back, holding a wooden recurve bow.

jobs.name: c_ranger
jobs.d: A Windhawk Tracker ranger: dark green hooded cloak, leather bracers, a small brown hawk perched on one shoulder, holding a sturdy hunting bow, alert eyes.

jobs.name: c_sharpshooter
jobs.d: A Starpiercer marksman: dark grey long coat with pink-red trim, a feathered hat, holding a tall dark longbow with a glowing pink arrow nocked, cool confident smirk.

jobs.name: c_cleric
jobs.d: A kind cleric with auburn hair, a white hood, cream white robe with gold trim, holding a golden mace-rod with a small sun emblem, warm gentle smile, soft holy glow.

jobs.name: c_highcleric
jobs.d: A Dawnkeeper high priest: pure white robe with sky-blue trim, a tall gold-trimmed mitre, a blue cape, holding a radiant staff of pale golden light, serene expression.

jobs.name: c_templar
jobs.d: A Sunfist Ascetic monk-warrior: sand-colored gi with dark red sash, a light helm, bare fists wrapped in cloth glowing with small sun flames, energetic fighting stance.

jobs.name: c_thief
jobs.d: A nimble thief with dark hair, a red bandana, a dark plum outfit with crimson trim, a cloth mask over the mouth, holding a short silver dagger, playful sly eyes.

jobs.name: c_assassin
jobs.d: An Eclipseblade assassin: black hooded outfit with crimson accents, a red scarf flowing, holding twin curved blades, crescent moon motif on the belt, sharp eyes.

jobs.name: c_nightblade
jobs.d: A Nightblade shadow rogue: dark indigo hooded outfit with violet trim, a violet mask, wisps of purple shadow smoke around the feet, holding a glowing lilac dagger.

jobs.name: e_shambler
jobs.d: A cute chibi zombie: green-grey skin, torn brown villager clothes, stiff arms forward, one droopy eye, small stitches, comically clumsy pose, not gory.

jobs.name: e_runner
jobs.d: A fast chibi zombie runner: thin, reddish skin tone, ragged red scarf, leaning forward mid-sprint, wide manic grin, not gory.

jobs.name: e_bat
jobs.d: A small round purple bat monster with big ears, tiny fangs, leathery wings spread, mischievous expression.

jobs.name: e_spitter
jobs.d: A chibi skeleton archer: bone-white body, a small tattered hood, holding a crude bow, glowing pale yellow eye sockets, goofy toothy grin.

jobs.name: e_bloater
jobs.d: A round puffed-up chibi zombie, lime-green swollen belly, tiny limbs, cheeks puffed like about to burst, comical, not gross.

jobs.name: e_brute
jobs.d: A big hulking chibi zombie giant: purple-grey skin, huge arms, tiny head, broken chain on one wrist, angry pout.

jobs.name: e_wraith
jobs.d: A floating pale-blue ghost wraith wrapped in a tattered translucent cloak, glowing eyes, wispy tail instead of legs, eerie but cute.

jobs.name: b_colossus
jobs.d: The Black Bone Colossus: a huge chibi giant made of dark stacked bones and ivory plates, glowing ember-orange core in the ribcage, heavy fists, imposing but cute proportions.

jobs.name: b_lich
jobs.d: The Soulless Lich: a tall robed undead sorcerer in tattered violet and black robes, a crown of dark crystals, skeletal hands holding a staff with a swirling purple soul flame, floating, imposing but cute proportions.

jobs.name: b_king
jobs.d: The Emperor of Death: a giant armored undead emperor in black and crimson plate armor, a jagged golden crown, a huge dark greatsword with red glowing runes, flowing crimson cape, menacing pose, imposing but cute chibi proportions.

jobs.name: m_strawbeetle
jobs.d: A small round beetle with a golden straw-woven shell pattern, little antennae, tiny legs, sleepy calm face.

jobs.name: m_embersquirrel
jobs.d: A tiny squirrel with an ember-orange fluffy tail whose tip glows like a smoldering coal, big sparkling eyes, holding an acorn.

jobs.name: m_onion
jobs.d: A walking onion monster: plump round onion bulb body striped purple and cream, two tiny stubby legs, a tuft of green sprout leaves on top, a simple cute face with two round dot eyes and a small pouting mouth, nothing on the face except eyes and mouth.

jobs.name: m_gustcrow
jobs.d: A small slate-blue crow with swirling wind ribbons around its wings, a teal crest, beady clever eyes, mid-flight.

jobs.name: m_vinescare
jobs.d: A scarecrow monster made of twisted green vines and burlap, a stitched cloth head with a gentle stitched smile, small leaves sprouting, arms outstretched.

jobs.name: m_amberbee
jobs.d: A round fuzzy bee with an amber crystal stinger and glowing rune markings on its body, tiny translucent wings, cheerful face.

jobs.name: m_rootmole
jobs.d: A chubby brown mole wearing a tiny miner headlamp, big digging claws holding a clump of dirt and roots, squinting nearsighted eyes.

jobs.name: m_gourdlamp
jobs.d: A floating bottle-gourd lantern spirit glowing warm orange from inside, carved friendly face, small flame wisps around it.

jobs.name: m_mistcrab
jobs.d: A pale grey-blue crab with a misty translucent shell, wisps of fog drifting from its back, big pincers raised defensively.

jobs.name: m_inksquid
jobs.d: A small dark navy squid floating, curled tentacles, little ink droplets around it, round shiny eyes, mischievous look.

jobs.name: m_mooneel
jobs.d: A slender silver eel coiling in a loop, pale moonlight glow along its fins, a crescent-moon mark on its forehead, calm glowing eyes.

jobs.name: m_mistwisp
jobs.d: A tiny floating fog spirit, a soft white-lavender cloud body with a little glowing core, small sleepy face, trailing mist.

jobs.name: fb_ramking
jobs.d: The Stone-horn Ram King as a round, fluffy chibi ram: very big head, short stubby legs, huge curled horns made of grey stone with glowing amber rune cracks, puffy cream wool like a cloud, a tiny golden crown between the horns, determined angry pout, charging pose.

jobs.name: fb_vinemother
jobs.d: The Thousand-year Vine Mother: a giant gentle-but-stern plant guardian with a body of woven green vines and bark, a crown of pink flowers, long vine tendrils like arms, glowing amber eyes.

jobs.name: fb_isleback
jobs.d: The Isleback: a giant chibi sea turtle carrying a small misty island with trees and a tiny lighthouse on its shell, barnacles, wise old eyes, rising from mist.
